concept: Take the viewer inside the mechanism, not the scoreboard: a wordmark poster, a 4-node diagram of how the skill actually rewrites the system prompt, a real terminal invocation with its real output, the README's own honest caveat, the token receipt that proves the trick works, an inverted beat naming the wenyan tier as a repo-reader's easter egg, the star climb, and a close that rhymes with the open.
money_shot_note: Scene 6 (flash, inverted polarity) naming wenyan is the peak: it is the one detail that proves the video's maker actually read the code, not just the star chart, and it lands at 71% of the runtime.
transition_strategy: Hard cuts on the beat throughout, slightly softer fade in/out on the honesty (mono_block) beat to mark it as a tonal pause before the receipt and the inverted peak.
music_direction: electronic, mid-tempo, mechanical but not aggressive, room for the inverted beat to land as a genuine accent hit

scenes.intent: establish the project name as the frame-0 poster before any claim is made
scenes.copy_note: wordmark plus a tagline that states the mechanism in one line
scenes.sound_cue: soft synth swell under the kinetic wordmark settle

scenes.intent: show the actual architecture so the trick reads as engineering, not a joke
scenes.copy_note: 4 nodes: install hook, system prompt, terse reply, fewer tokens, drawn on in sequence
scenes.sound_cue: four short ticks as each node draws on

scenes.intent: prove the mechanism with a real invocation and its real documented output
scenes.copy_note: types /caveman, replies Me ready., sourced verbatim from the project's own docs page
scenes.sound_cue: keystroke ticks typing on, a soft chime on the reply line

scenes.intent: give the project's own documented honesty its moment, the tonal pause before the payoff
scenes.copy_note: the skill costs input tokens too, documented as net negative sometimes

scenes.intent: land the receipt: the actual before and after token counts that justify the whole premise
scenes.copy_note: before 1180 tokens out, after 159 tokens out, cut 87 percent, average 65 percent typical cut
scenes.sound_cue: rising synth stab under each stat landing

scenes.intent: reward a close reader with the one detail only someone who opened the repo would know, the inverted-polarity peak
scenes.copy_note: word wenyan, caption naming it as classical chinese prose
scenes.sound_cue: full accent hit, brief silence after

scenes.intent: show the scoreboard is real, after the mechanics have already earned it
scenes.copy_note: star curve from launch to 82k, count-up value label
scenes.sound_cue: synth arpeggio climbing with the line draw

scenes.intent: close on a composition that rhymes with the open so the autoloop reads clean
scenes.copy_note: reframe the thesis without repeating scene 1's tagline wording
scenes.sound_cue: swell resolves back to the opening pad
